mapper.insert: insert into hr_attendance_rule( rule_id, late_minutes, early_minutes, absent_minutes, day_close_minutes, multi_punch_strategy, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time ) values( #{ruleId}, #{lateMinutes}, #{earlyMinutes}, #{absentMinutes}, #{dayCloseMinutes}, #{multiPunchStrategy}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{updateBy}, sysdate() )
